metadata.author: Benjiman Jennings
metadata.title: Dental PI Objectives Export — Recovery
metadata.demo_effect: Shows objective progress rebounding after the mitigation plan is accepted.

payload.summary: The dental product's objectives are progressing with varying degrees of completion and risk. Key milestones include the completion of FHIR endpoint mapping, delivery of a security assessment, readiness of the test environment, and approval of a mitigation plan.
warnings: The test environment is only partially ready with full access still pending.
The stakeholder demo can proceed against mock services if needed, indicating potential delays or issues with the actual services.
